svg.title: Incident lifecycle — state and permission checks

g.text: Incident lifecycle — state and permission checks
Calculate score, priority and SLA deadlines
Administrator assigns when capacity is available
Add notes / request and receive information
Reporter / assigned technician / administrator provides reopening justification
Preserve records, feedback and audit history
Every action validates role, ownership and current IncidentState.
Disallowed transitions return HTTP 409 with no committed mutation.
SLA scheduler independently records warnings, violations and escalations.
Closed incidents can be reopened with justification and an audit event.
